lines.beaver: 어머, 이게 무슨 냄새야? 솥에서 탄 냄새 나.
lines.beaver_en: Oh my, what's that smell? Something's burning in the pot.
lines.beaver_roman: eomeo, ige museun naemsaeya? soteseo tan naemsae na.
lines.en: Mom, I'm sorry. As you can see, I burned the rice.

lines.beaver_en: It was made with new rice... What a waste.
lines.learner: 햅쌀을 헹구고 물을 너무 적게 넣었나 봐요.
lines.en: I rinsed the new rice but must have added too little water.
lines.roman: haepssareul henggugo mureul neomu jeokge neoeonna bwayo.

lines.beaver_en: How's the soup? Did you simmer the bones well?
lines.learner: 불을 세게 해서 펄펄 끓이기만 했어요.
lines.en: I turned the heat up high and just boiled it hard.
lines.roman: bureul sege haeseo peolpeol kkeurigiman haesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: You have to simmer it long on low heat for the flavor to come out.
Did you skim off the fat? The broth is cloudy.
lines.learner: 기름을 안 걷어내서 그대로 떠 있어요.
lines.en: I didn't skim the fat, so it's still floating there.
lines.roman: gireumeul an geodeonaeseo geudaero tteo isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Should we try adding more seasoning?
lines.en: Should we try adding some salt and green onion?

lines.beaver_en: And the steamed eggs? Did you mix the yolks well?
lines.en: I didn't stir the yolks enough, so it looks weird.

lines.beaver_en: It's okay. What side dishes should we serve with it?
lines.en: How about serving aged kimchi and stir-fried nuts with it?

lines.beaver_en: Sounds good. Is this flower just for decoration?
lines.en: No, it's an edible flower, so you can eat it.

lines.beaver_en: Well done. Next time let's take it slow together.
lines.learner: 네, 다음엔 약불로 천천히 고아 볼게요.
lines.en: Okay, next time I'll simmer it slowly on low heat.
lines.roman: ne, daeumen yakbullo cheoncheonhi goa bolgeyo.
